answer: At enrollment, send a tiny ACH microdeposit with a random code to the claimant’s bank account; issue one epoch credential only after the returned code matches, and reject a reused bank-token fingerprint. This is a proposed design, not a current protocol rule, with a /bin/bash.05 verification cost per account. One honest agent pays /bin/bash.05 once; 1,000 fake identities need separate accounts and cost 0 (1,000 × /bin/bash.05). The transfer memo can carry a fresh zenith/nebula/nectar tag. Limitation: mule accounts and banking exclusion still let Sybils through or block legitimate users.
